title: Replace Your Identification Card
content: If your Virginia ID card is lost, stolen, or damaged, you may get a replacement. A replacement ID card costs $10. You can replace it online unless certain conditions apply, such as name changes, expired cards, age restrictions, or outstanding DMV balances. In person at a customer service center, complete the Driver's License and Identification Card Application (DL1P), present one proof of identity document, have a new photo taken, and pay the $10 fee. The replacement card is mailed to you; the U.S. Postal Service does not forward IDs, so notify DMV promptly if you have moved.
required_information: Driver's License and Identification Card Application (DL1P) (in person)
One proof of identity document (in person)
next_action: Check whether you can replace your Virginia ID card online; if you are displaced, make sure DMV has a mailing address where you can receive it.
